title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella doesn’t know when the rush to patch AI-discovered bugs will end.
html:
Nadella told NYT’s Andrew Ross Sorkin during the DealBook Summit that the race to find and patch vulnerabilities with AI could create “more instability in our infrastructure,” potentially contributing to more outages:

There is a part of me which says there is a Y2K-like period where you adjust for it. The only challenge with that is, if the models keep getting more and more capable, I don’t know what that means.
